name: GPT-6.1 Terra
summary: Run coding, computer-use, and visual tasks faster with a mid-tier model priced at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output. Use it via the API as gpt-6.1-terra, or in Codex and ChatGPT Work on paid plans.

name: myPip
summary: Build playable games by describing an idea, then change them through conversation. Start free in your browser, with built-in multiplayer and shared editing so friends can help build and test the same game.

name: zCAD AI
summary: Create 3D parts with real dimensions from text or a reference image, then export them to your design software. Try it free for non-commercial projects, with private models and commercial use on paid plans.

name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
summary: Build apps, fix bugs, and create 3D models from prompts or reference images. Use it in Kimi chat, Kimi Code, or through the API, with a faster version available on higher subscription plans.

name: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
summary: Power cheap, fast agents with a 1M-token model that reads text, images, and video. Call it through the low-cost API or download the open weights from Hugging Face, free for non-commercial use with attribution required for commercial products.

name: Canva Craft
summary: Generate product graphics, posters, and social images at up to 2K resolution, with prompts that specify layout, object placement, and text. Use it in Canva’s Dream Lab or add image generation to your app through the public API.

name: Resend Inboxes
summary: Give your AI agents an email address to receive tasks, track conversations, and draft replies. Connect through an API, CLI, or MCP, with up to three free inboxes and controls over what agents can do.

name: Flint
summary: Fix bugs and build features with a coding model that runs on your own computer. Download the Apache 2.0 weights for Ollama or LM Studio, or use the optimized Mac runner on supported chips with at least 48 GB of memory.
